purpose: Express an intense feeling through a formal fixed phrase.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
I am deeply honored to be invited.
I am profoundly moved by your words.
I was utterly embarrassed to have my lack of study pointed out.
restrictions: Common with 光栄, 感激, and 赤面.
mistake: Not freely attachable to every feeling noun.
